content:
mira: Quick noteNew rk7b-ptq run on anchor_mini shows NDCG@10 -0.02 vs fp16, MRR stable. Anyone free to triage?
devin: I'll look. Which eval params? topk, tokenizer, batch?
mira: topk=100 (eval default), tokenizer=0.15, batch-size=4. PTQ build metadata lists tokenizer=0.13.
sara: Tokenizer mismatch likely. Also topk mismatch can hide top10 reorderings. Run parity with topk=10 and tokenizer=0.15 first.
chao: Add `--kvpack false --batch-size 1` to rule out packing heuristics. We had similar tail regressions before from kvpack.
ci-bot: CI queued jobs: 7201 (tokenizer+topk parity), 7202 (kvpack/batch parity). Artifacts to s3://redwood-debug/rerank/1801112222/.
devin: Running parity now on small split. Command: `python -m eval.rerank --model rk7b-ptq --anchors anchor_mini --tokenizer 0.15 --topk 10 --seed 3`
ci-bot: Job 7201 finished. Tokenizer+topk parity removed majority of gap: ndcg10_delta=-0.006 (p=0.19). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/rerank/7201/artifacts.json
mira: Great Looks like tooling drift. I'll open a PTQ CI gate to enforce tokenizer parity and pin topk for eval. Thanks all.
ci-bot: Job 7202 finished later: kvpack/batch parity had negligible effect in this case.
mira: Closing; follow-up PR for CI gate incoming.
